verdict.rationale: Statsig's Console API reference gives each endpoint an in-page "Try it" control that sends a live request to that endpoint. It is backed by a public, versioned OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec that Statsig commits to keeping up to date, and API-reference pages also exist for HTTP API endpoints such as checking gates and logging events. The 404s from the docs-site OpenAPI probe do not contradict this, because the spec is published at api.statsig.com. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of copyable multi-language code samples on reference pages, confirmation that the live runner also covers the HTTP API reference, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
